personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for high-utility, Arabic-first, and low-end Android performance)
personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly functional Levantine transit utility that prioritizes instant readability and calm, earthy warmth over gamified tech aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (44pt+) and comfortable padding to ensure readability on cheap screens and outside in bright sunlight. Use flex gaps over rigid margins where possible.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with shadow tier 1 for elevated cards and bottom sheets to maintain performance on cheap Androids.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism on the map overlays or bottom sheets—use solid Levantine off-white (surface) to keep the app highly performant and battery-friendly.

screens.name: RoleSelection
screens.purpose: A welcoming, full-bleed hero screen where users pick 'Passenger' or 'Driver'.

states.loading: Spinner in the center of the hero image
states.error: Standard snackbar error for network failures

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim (Layer 1). At the bottom 30%, two large, pill-shaped buttons ('Passenger' and 'Driver') styled with brandPrimary and surfaceInverse. Text overlay uses onSurfaceInverse.

screens.name: PassengerMapSearch
screens.purpose: The core passenger view featuring the map and the 'Where are you going?' (وين رايح؟) search.

states.loading: Skeleton rows inside the bottom sheet for recent destinations
states.empty: Illustration of a bus icon in a tinted brandTertiary container with 'No recent destinations'
states.error: Retry button above the search bar

screens.layout: Map view fills flex: 1. OpenStreetMap tiles used. Pinned at the bottom is a @gorhom/bottom-sheet starting at 30% height, expanding to 70%. The sheet contains a large text input (وين رايح؟) and a vertical list of recent destinations (minimum 56pt height tappable rows). RTL aligned.

screens.name: PassengerWaiting
screens.purpose: Shows live ETAs of approaching buses after a destination is selected.

states.loading: Spinner centered in the bottom sheet
states.empty: No buses on this route currently illustration.
states.error: Error message with 'Retry' button in the sheet.

screens.layout: Map in the background showing route corridor. Bottom sheet contains list of approaching buses. High contrast route numbers using brandPrimary. A sticky 'I'm waiting here' (أنا مستني هون) button pinned at the very bottom inside a SafeAreaView with surface background.

screens.name: DriverLogin
screens.purpose: Phone and OTP login strictly for drivers.

states.error: Red error text below the input field using error token

screens.layout: Clean single-column form. Large Arabic numerals for input. Label above input. Primary CTA sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: DriverActiveTrip
screens.purpose: Live demand-visibility dashboard for the driver showing waiting passengers ahead.

states.error: Network disconnected banner at the top of the screen

screens.layout: High-contrast utility layout. Large central metric card ('٣ ركاب بانتظارك') using displayFontFamily. Map is minimized or secondary. A large 'End Trip' (خلصت) button sticky at the bottom.

splash_bg.alt: Minimal landscape of Jordan with earthy tones

city_transit_hero.alt: Street view of Amman Jordan focusing on transit and mobility

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce RTL layout (`I18nManager.forceRTL(true)`) for all text, chevrons, and layout directions.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the earthy Levantine palette defined in the color object (Olive green, rust, sand, ochre).
Font weight MUST NOT exceed 500 anywhere. Create hierarchy through size (scale tokens) and color contrast, not heavy bold cuts.

Disable glassmorphism/blur overlays entirely. Since this app targets cheap Android devices and weak 3G networks, use solid `surfaceSecondary` with `shadow_tier: 1` for elevated components like the bottom sheet.
Implement a mandatory vertical gradient scrim (`expo-linear-gradient` transparent to 80% surfaceInverse) on the RoleSelection hero image before placing text or buttons on top.
Ensure 'وين رايح؟' and 'أنا مستني هون' CTAs are pinned to the bottom (sticky) and wrapped in SafeAreaView so they are easily reachable with the thumb.
DriverActiveTrip must be high-contrast and readable under direct sunlight. Large metrics should use the display font.
Always provide Empty, Loading, and Error states for map data and lists, filling the available flex space.
